80: # rename CONFIG_xxx to CONFIG_xxx_AMDKCL
81: # otherwise kernel config would override dkms package config
82: AMDGPU_CONFIG=$(find -name Kconfig -exec grep -h '^config' {} + | sed 's/ /_/' | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z')
83: TTM_CONFIG=$(awk '/CONFIG_DRM/{gsub(".*\\(CONFIG_DRM","CONFIG_DRM");gsub("\\).*","");print $0}' ttm/Makefile)
84: SCHED_CONFIG=$(awk '/CONFIG_DRM/{gsub(".*\\(CONFIG_DRM","CONFIG_DRM");gsub("\\).*","");print $0}' scheduler/Makefile)
85: for config in $AMDGPU_CONFIG $TTM_CONFIG $SCHED_CONFIG; do
86: 	for file in $(grep -rl $config ./); do
87: 		sed -i "s/\<$config\>/&_AMDKCL/" $file
88: 	done
89: 	sed -i "/${config}$/s/$/_AMDKCL/" amd/dkms/Kbuild
90: done

500: ### 4.5 Post-AC recovery and fresh 4K launch
501: 
502: After the user reported an AC cycle, the boot ID was
503: `6ef5adda-fa87-4225-9fa2-99f733c74604`. All four GPUs were present on PCI, but
504: AMDGPU and `/dev/kfd` were absent because the existing boot configuration
505: blacklists automatic driver loading. The recorded restore command was
506: `sudo -n modprobe amdgpu noretry=0 gpu_recovery=0 ip_block_mask=0xcff`; it
507: completed at **22:56:54.826 UTC September 19**, without a persistent boot
508: configuration change. The existing container, image and mounts were retained.
509: 
510: All four ranks passed a bounded FP32/BF16 indexing/matmul and RCCL
511: all-reduce/all-to-all preflight in **3.959 seconds**. The host wrapper began
512: at **22:57:39.448 UTC** and recorded the detached training launch at
513: **22:57:39.634 UTC**. The prepared 4K run had not launched before the AC cycle,
514: and no checkpoint existed. This was fresh initialization with the settings
515: in §3.5, original automatic sharding and default allocator behavior.
516: 
517: The run directory is
518: `/home/chcai/runs/mi450_4gpu_4k_auc075_post_ac_20260919T225739Z/`.

contents.scope: Read-only current A0 parameters; no claim these values equal historical training405 or successful1P4G.

local_boot_block_order.scope: Observed local restored baseline boot, first GPU; remote registered order absent.

ip_block_mask.index_domain: adev->ip_blocks registration index, not enum amd_ip_block_type
ip_block_mask.remote_condition: VCN/JPEG interpretation requires same block registration order; no evidence of CWSR or MES disable from this mask.

noretry.queue_selection: xnack_enabled = !kfd->noretry; updates RETRY_DISABLE and VM retry-permission/invalid-page-fault bit
noretry.latching_limit: Global noretry is writable0644 but gmc and KFD fields are initialized/copied; sysfs parameter alone does not attest arbitrary post-write queue state.
noretry.boot_log_limit: gfx_v12_1 SH_MEM_CONFIG print reads preexisting RLC value before init; mixed log values do not attest final process queue retry mode.
noretry.remote_limit: Local semantics only until successful module/source and effective initialization are verified. HSA_XNACK and selected code-object mode unrecorded.

recovery.gpu_recovery_zero: Disables generic GPU recovery and KFD MES queue-reset paths shown here
recovery.gpu_recovery_minus_one_on_local_gfx12_1: Generic recovery permitted; none of the legacy ASIC exceptions applies
recovery.halt_if_hws_hang: Both records report0; classic-HWS hang handler waits while nonzero
recovery.causal_limit: Controls post-failure behavior; these paths do not remove the first-level bank-copy instructions.

CWSR_and_scheduler.sched_policy_0: HWS with oversubscription permitted, not observed oversubscription
CWSR_and_scheduler.gfx12_1_discovery: Selects MES12.1 and enables MES/MES-KIQ; Unified MES conditional on uni_mes
CWSR_and_scheduler.hws_max_conc_proc_minus_one: Resolved to count of KFD VMIDs for classic HWS max_proc_per_quantum; not proof of MES firmware active-process count
CWSR_and_scheduler.4096: Queue allocation/admission ceiling, not active queue count
CWSR_and_scheduler.9000ms: Classic unmap_queues_cpsch completion wait, not preemption cadence
CWSR_and_scheduler.quantum_limit: Parameters submitted to MES, not measured trap cadence or proof of mid-kernel preemption

conclusions: The documented mask most plausibly excludes VCN/JPEG under the verified local order; it is not evidence of disabled compute/MES/CWSR.
Retry mode is a substantive candidate execution difference under local source semantics, not a proven explanation for successful training.
Recovery is post-failure policy; queue limits and timeouts cannot be turned into trap-frequency claims.
Successful run native identity, operands, effective queue state, handler bytes and entry history remain the decisive missing evidence.
